description: This file implements a client class for managing teams via API calls in the LiteLLM proxy system. It provides methods for listing teams, getting paginated lists, and fetching available teams, including handling authentication and request errors.

classes.name: TeamsManagementClient
classes.description: A client class for managing team-related API interactions with the LiteLLM proxy server.

methods.name: __init__(self, base_url: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Initializes a TeamsManagementClient instance with base URL and optional API key for authentication.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _get_headers(self)
methods.description: Generates request headers including Authorization header if API key is provided.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list( self, user_id: Optional[str] = None, organization_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of teams the user belongs to, with optional filtering by user ID and organization ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] list_v2( self, user_id: Optional[str] = None, organization_id: Optional[str] = None, team_id: Optional[str] = None, team_alias: Optional[str] = None, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 10, sort_by: Optional[str] = None, sort_order: str = "asc", )
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated, sortable list of teams with various filtering options.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_available(self)
methods.description: Fetches a list of teams that are available for the user to join.
